column3: With respect to the Soudry NYC Multifamily Portfolio Mortgage Loan (7.7%), 32 of the 204 multifamily units at the related Mortgaged Properties are rent stabilized. 16 of such 32 rent stabilized units are located at the 2848 Brighton 7th Street Mortgaged Property (0.4%), which is subject to a 421-a tax abatement. See “Description of the Mortgage Pool—Real Estate and Other Tax Considerations”.
